sources.snippet: Noggin is an open-source AI-powered adaptive learning platform built for students with special educational needs. Utilizing an AI-driven engine built on neuroplasticity research, the system creates a personalized curriculum that adjusts difficulty and teaching styles in real time to accommodate conditions like ADHD, autism, and dyslexia.
